newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA 54,000T soy tender delayed to Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA 54,000T soy tender delayed to Friday.

text.p: The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association has delayed to Friday its planned Thursday tender for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans and eliminated the United States as a source, traders said.
The tender, which had specified U.S. or Argentine soybeans when announced on Wednesday, was revised to include Brazil as a possible source.
The line specifying the United States as a possible source was simply struck out in the respecification, which traders said was a reflection of persistently high prices for soybeans.
The breakfast association's Taichung division consists of Sino Japan Feed Corp, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed, Fwu Sow Grain and Tay Shan.
